sections.heading: What is trending: “the dark”
paragraphs: “the dark” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for IE (snapshot taken 2026-09-04T00:06:28+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 200 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Attack of the Fanboy, Audacy, The Chenab Times. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “EPA Proposal May Limit Public Data Center Oversight” — The Chenab Times
“Environmental Groups and States Fight Proposed EPA Rule Change on Data Center Air Permits” — Audacy

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Thu, 3 Sep 2026 14:10:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-09-04T00:06:28+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-09-04T00:07:15+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
